evals.prompt: Add a skill that helps me rename a git branch safely.
evals.expected_output: A new sibling folder with SKILL.md. The description is one sentence, 60 characters or fewer, and does not repeat the skill name.
assertions: Creates a folder next to new-skill, not inside it.
description is 60 characters or fewer and ends with a period.
description does not repeat the folder name.
When to use lives in the body, not in description.
Adds one line to the collection README.

evals.prompt: Write a skill whose description lists every trigger phrase I might say, including buy, share, sign, and audit.
evals.expected_output: The skill is still written, but the description stays at or under 60 characters. Trigger phrases go in When to Use.
assertions: Does not put a long trigger list in description.
Counted the description or showed the count.
Trigger phrases appear in the skill body.

evals.prompt: Make a skill for this collection that tells the agent how to use our setup.
evals.expected_output: The new skill does not name a specific agent product.
assertions: Does not name a specific agent product in the new files.
Follows the house shape (When to Use, Steps, You're done when).

evals.prompt: Add a skill for cleaning CSV files. I have not picked a name.
evals.expected_output: Proposes one short hyphen name and waits, or uses a short name and says it.
assertions: Does not invent a long title with spaces as the folder name.
Folder name is lowercase with hyphens.

evals.prompt: The hinge skill should also dump a full truth report. Update it.
evals.expected_output: Does not treat this as new-skill work. Says to edit hinge in place.
assertions: Does not create a second hinge folder.
Does not rewrite hinge as a new skill.
